_comment: POST /api/rooms/{roomId}/commands receipts. Server: store.command returns {sequence, event, duplicate}; a same-id/different-payload retry is 409 idempotency_conflict (fingerprint covers the whole envelope, including data.messageId). Error shape mirrors docs/ERROR-TAXONOMY.md.

error.message: Command ID already used for different content

conflict.hint: Re-read state; the original command already landed or a different command holds this id.
